name: @mavis/durable-orchestration
description: W08 part A (PORT-PI-1.3): merged orchestration-state persistence. The pinned pi-durable Harness — opened over OUR full pi Storage adapter — is the ONE durable scheduler: task phases are owned by its TaskScheduler, product state (goal / background task / cron wakeup / roster) persists as pi documents and pi task records through this bridge. Product supervisors/policies (goal UX, background-task manager, cron config, delegation supervisor) stay on top as adapters; no competing cron/task scheduler and no second persistence path may be created beside it.
